verdicts.reason: A re-flows properly for the square: the headline is set large across 4 lines and clearly dominates. Its flaws are the bottom row: the subcopy is centre-aligned in its own left column and doesn't line up with the headline axis or the button, and the subcopy-plus-CTA row feels squeezed under a very tall headline. B is the original at the same size, spread vertically with big, disconnected gaps between headline, subcopy and CTA and large empty bands top and bottom; the headline is undersized for the canvas and the tiny subcopy floats alone, so it reads as a shrunk copy rather than a redesign.
